# tfrSURFs 1.1.0

## Plots

* By default, the legends of the main plots generated by `plot_tfr_surfs()` only show the stalls or SURFs that actually occur.
* TFR and SURF probabilities are plotted at the mid-year value on the x-axis. 
* Distinctive borders added to shaded regions delineating stalls and SURFs. 
* By default, SURFs in the projection period are no longer added to plots. 
* Moved function `plot_alt_surfs()` from the sensitivity analysis appendix into the package.


## General Changes

* The vignette has been merged into the README file. 
* The package documentation has been updated.
* Unused code and function options have been tidied up. 
* Fixed various small bugs. 


# tfrSURFs 1.0.0

* Initial version to accompany the manuscript "Caught in Transit: Identifying Stalls, Upswings and Reversals in Fertility Transitions For All Countries using a Probabilistic Approach" (V2), available [here](https://doi.org/10.31235/osf.io/u6r7n_v2 "Link to preprint of 'Caught in Transit: Identifying ...'").
